gen-mystery-quest-gf-tiny5: Mystery Quest leaves every curved stroke open-jawed, bookish and nostalgic. Tiny5 keeps its ascenders looking stubby, so a long run of text feels friendly and compact rather than fussy.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-truculenta: Truculenta packs its sans letters into a snug line, rounded forms still open at the sides. And Mystery Quest, with its open-jawed curves, belongs up big and brief, where the bookish mood can land.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-viga: Mystery Quest cuts open jaws into every curve, nostalgic and bookish. Viga's plain sans strokes carry no hairlines or shadows, and its capitals barely rise above their neighbors, which makes a quiet foundation under those open curves.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-voces: Bookish, nostalgic, open-jawed: Mystery Quest sets the mood while Voces, a sans, builds its lowercase high. But the real strength is a body whose stems and hairlines stay close in weight.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough holds its lowercase nearly level with the capitals. Mystery Quest handles the bookish, nostalgic side with open-jawed curves, while this plain sans keeps the text feeling contemporary.
gen-mystery-quest-outfit: Mystery Quest cuts open jaws into every curve, a bookish, nostalgic face with compact ascenders over a generous lowercase. Let the heading go large and leave Outfit's plain sans at ordinary size.
gen-mystery-quest-space-grotesk: Bookish, nostalgic, jaws open on every curve: that is Mystery Quest, with its high lowercase and compact ascenders. Mystery Quest sets the mood; Space Grotesk's geometric, constant-width ribbon does the talking.
gen-nixie-one-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Nostalgic, retro-tech Nixie One keeps its curves open and its strokes constant. Pilcrow Rounded is plain sans with generous counters and a high lowercase, packed tightly beneath the retro-tech heading for a warm finish.
gen-nixie-one-gf-assistant: Nixie One draws each stroke at a constant width, with open curves and clear gaps. And while it belongs big and brief, Assistant's plain sans mouths stay open for contemporary text.
gen-nixie-one-gf-biz-udgothic: Nixie One glows like neon glass tubing, with open curves. Give the heading plenty of size, and let BIZ UDGothic, a modern sans-serif with a wide channel into every bowl, handle ordinary text.
